purpose: Locate actual reseat conflicts before changing carrier placement ordering.
candidate_change: In Engine::attempt_pack_impl, replace pack_interior_order(names,tiers,connections,areas) with pack_interior_order(names,tiers,areas,connections). This retains ascending priority tiers, makes area the descending primary within-tier key, connectivity secondary, and name the final tie-breaker. Diagnostic only; not integrated.
instrumentation: Compile a private copy of floorplan_pack.cpp with successful retry logging (subject, victim, outline, punch policy, poses), link it ahead of the current schgen_core static archive, and reuse compact_stage_profile.cpp. Both executables use the same logging and -O2 -ffp-contract=off; archive is the current Release build. No solver calls or accounting events are removed or replayed.
decision: Reject broad area-first ordering: both area and actual retries regress. Preserve the production carrier incumbent and investigate bounded conflict-aware reconsideration that retains useful connectivity ordering. No hard-coded board-name priority was added.
limitations: Only placement-contract, placement-flow and enforced composition checks ran after construction; no full acceptance, DRC, source audit, render or publication.
Single instrumented samples are diagnostic, not a statistical performance claim or historical Python comparison.
Reseats count all executed search work, including losing candidates and both punch policies; they are not just movements on the final board.
Baseline PCB hash matches the uninstrumented current carrier screen, supporting probe non-interference; byte identity is not an optimisation acceptance criterion.
